category_edits.rationale: Test equal weighting of nonempty sequences across all four datasets by averaging the existing pointwise logistic loss within each sequence before averaging sequences. This may better match user-averaged evaluation. Only loss reduction changes; model and predictor remain compatible.

edits.find:
loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
edits.replace:
loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
    valid_counts = mask.sum(dim=1)
    sequence_loss = (loss * mask).sum(dim=1) / valid_counts.clamp(min=1.0)
    nonempty = (valid_counts > 0).to(dtype=loss.dtype)
    return (sequence_loss * nonempty).sum() / nonempty.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
